## Functions

### `coupleFluidRigidContacts(particles, shapes, radius, module)`

Dissipative normal contact between SPH volumes and native rigid shapes. Call after a fixed fluid/rigid step, then publish velocities to PhysX. This is contact coupling, not a hydrodynamic boundary-density formulation. Static axis-aligned floors may set oneSidedTop to retain their upper half-space through a rigid overlap repair. Ordinary boxes remain two-sided.
